MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The shorter WoodPro screws felt like a natural next choice because they complement my recent two-inch screws while keeping the same brand, screw size and T20 drive.",
    "The J-B Weld epoxy fits small repair needs alongside my fastening supplies, giving me another way to mend something when screws or nails are unsuitable."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Locking nuts and metal-cutting wheels serve different jobs from the wood fastening reflected in my recent purchases; I have no immediate task for either.",
    "Eighteen rolls of duct tape and twelve wastebaskets are quantities I would not choose for my current needs.",
    "Oil, silicone sealant, removable fastening strips and caster wheels each require a specific task I do not currently have. Being useful repair supplies alone does not make them timely purchases."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My purchases seem to have been interpreted as broad interest in any workshop or repair supply, although I choose items for particular jobs.",
    "Buying large packs of nails seems to have been extended to bulk supplies generally, but my need for many fasteners does not imply a need for many rolls of tape or wastebaskets."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The exact fastening details matter: shorter number-eight WoodPro screws with the same T20 drive complement supplies I already bought.",
    "My repeated nail and wood-screw purchases give a clearer indication of my current needs than a loose connection to household maintenance.",
    "I buy moderately and need a concrete use for an item; a related product is not enough unless it complements my current supplies or solves a plausible immediate repair."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my repair and fastening needs but stretched that interest too broadly into supplies for unrelated jobs and unnecessary bulk quantities."
}
